title: Vortex-sheet desingularization for three-dimensional ideal fluids
summary: We prove a desingularization theorem for analytic vortex sheets of the 3D incompressible Euler equations. Starting from an analytic solution of the corresponding Birkhoff-Rott system, we construct, for every sufficiently small thickness parameter $\varepsilon>0 $, an exact Euler vorticity supported on a tubular neighborhood of width $ O(\varepsilon) $ around the sheet, and defined on a time interval that does not shrink to 0 as $\varepsilon \to 0$.
